plan.explanation: Sequence starts with F1 face milling to establish datum. Then, M1 performs spot drilling and drilling for F2 (blind hole). M1 handles all operations for F3 (through hole: spot drill -> drill -> ream) and F4 (threaded hole: spot drill -> drill -> tap), respecting the precedence that drilling precedes reaming/tapping. Finally, M2 performs pocket milling on F5.
assumptions: F1 face milling is performed first to satisfy datum requirements before any other operations.
uncertainties: Tool life and wear are not considered; same tools assumed for all operations of the same type.
